name: Hybrid Voxel- and Surface-Guided Sampling
aliases: NeuS hierarchical importance sampling with SfM sparse volume
definition: A sampling strategy to improve training efficiency for neural implicit surface reconstruction in unconstrained Internet photo collections by reducing the search space from a unit bounding sphere to a sparse volume derived from Structure-from-Motion (SfM), and concentrating samples near the estimated surface.
summary: Hybrid Voxel- and Surface-Guided Sampling improves neural surface reconstruction efficiency by combining sparse volume voxel sampling with dynamic SDF-guided surface sampling to reduce search space and training time.
